definition: A specific contemplative recognition cultivated around abandoning.
notes: This compound should inherit the pahāna headword policy. Keep abandoning-language explicit rather than turning the phrase into generic letting-go language. The English follows the sanna record's default: recognition, not perception. Perception is discouraged here because readers take a perception to be a thing in its own right, something held and lasting, whereas sanna is the act of knowing the thing again -- re-cognizing it -- which is what this practice trains.

example_phrases.notes: Named contemplative perception in the release sequence.
